messages:
Marta V.: Idea: add a 'Simulate SLO' button in the console that projects alert volume + notify recipients for a given threshold and time window. Would save us from flipping a threshold blind.

Eli G.: love it. show both historical-based estimate (last 24h) and a burst model (99th percentile spike). UI should say which one you're looking at.

Noah P.: API side: expose POST /routes/:id/simulate with body {window, mode, tenant_context}. Return preview_id + metrics. Keep it async to protect notify service.

Marta V.: also display suggested mitigations: soften to p95, add soft-snooze 10m, or remove pager route. One click to open a canary rollout prefilled from preview_id.

release-bot: Deployed simulate-slo feature branch to staging (build 2026.03.22-0900). Please validate on sandbox tenant.

Eli G.: I'll run quick checks and draft the RFC with perf/cost constraints.
